general.paragraphOne: When a loan is due and cannot be repaid in full, the system pays as much as possible from the national treasury.
general.paragraphTwo: Any remaining balance is marked as overdue, and a penalty is added each month.
general.paragraphThree: This calculation applies to both bilateral and multilateral loans.

info.title: Loans & Debt Information
info.paragraphOne: Loans from other countries or international institutions increase both the treasury and national debt. Each loan has interest and a due date, so review its terms before accepting.
info.paragraphTwo: The debt-to-GDP ratio compares total debt with the size of the national economy. The base safe limit is 60% and may change with active bonuses. Monitor loan history and pay before the due date to avoid penalties.
